extracted.intended_audience: corporate sustainability teams, companies and financial institutions, media
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for companies and financial institutions to set, submit, and obtain validation for greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction targets that align with limiting global warming and achieving net-zero by 2050.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with limiting global warming and net-zero by 2050
rubrics_metrics.description: SBTi develops standards, tools and guidance which allow companies to set GHG emissions reduction targets in line with what is needed to limit global warming and reach net-zero by 2050 at the latest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets should be science-aligned — i.e., consistent with pathways that limit warming and achieve net-zero by 2050. This is the core substantive benchmark SBTi uses to judge corporate ambition; companies should design targets that reflect these global goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting GHG emissions reduction targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow companies and financial institutions worldwide to set GHG emissions reduction targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SBTi provides standards, tools, and guidance to help organizations define scope, timeframes, and reduction pathways for their GHG targets. The guidance implies that targets cover relevant emissions (scopes) and follow recognized methodologies, although detailed methodological requirements are provided by SBTi materials (linked from the project page).

rubrics_metrics.name: SBTi validation of targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Companies and financial institutions set emissions reduction targets and have them validated by the SBTi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtaining SBTi validation is presented as an evaluative step: organizations submit targets to SBTi for assessment against its standards. The page notes that by end of 2023 over 4,000 organizations had set targets and had them validated, indicating validation is the mechanism by which compliance with SBTi standards is confirmed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of SBTi standards, tools, and guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: SBTi develops standards, tools and guidance which allow companies to set GHG emissions reduction targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizations are expected to use SBTi's published standards, tools, and guidance when preparing targets. While this page summarizes the role of those resources, the detailed criteria, methodologies, and submission requirements are provided in SBTi's own documentation (accessible via the link to SBTi's website).
